reviews.title: Latest Version Has Broken Fast Playback
reviews.text: I’ve been listening as a subscriber for quite a while, but the latest version released this week has broken the fast playback feature. Any speed other than 1x introduces annoying artifacts in the playback, making it difficult to understand the speaker.

reviews.title: Sinful and Greedy Paywall
reviews.text: They’re slowly placing every feature behind a paywall. Soon you’ll have to pay $20 a month just to read the Bible. Why do I have to pay for the Daily Meditation now? And the saint of the day?? They’ve ruined their app; you’re much better off finding an app created for the purpose of spreading the Good Word, not for the purpose of making money. Try Hallow instead.

reviews.title: Too much behind paywall
reviews.text: This is a great and well made app. I understood putting some things behind a paywall to cover the cost of development, and to continue to make high quality content. However this used to just be longer programs and video series’. Recently they put the daily meditation behind one, and now even the saint of the day requires a premium subscription. I will be finding a different app.

reviews.title: It was good for a couple years
reviews.text: The app is not worth it. My BIAY was coming up now all of a sudden it’s a big hassle to find the right day. I will not renew. Use the free versions they work better.

reviews.title: Price
reviews.text: I think limiting this to adults with money is wrong for many reasons. There are kids who might want to access and can’t because they don’t have permission from a guardian. There are people who are poor and/or don’t have credit cards. Fr Mike gets so much funding from YouTube alone, where is that money going? The church pays for priests shelter, food, vehicles… but you have to pay to access the features in this app? It doesn’t seem right. It should be donation based, if the money is truly needed. Or put religious ads on for the people unable to pay, that way the ads pay for the $10/mo instead.

reviews.title: Frustrating how this App works
reviews.text: The content of this app is amazing, and God bless you all, you are providing outstanding and much needed education, but this app, UGH, it has always been extremely frustrating to navigate and get things to work. I’m a computer programmer, I’m old school, and the logic makes no sense. If I want to go back and listen to previous content, it’s impossible, you can’t go backward without a whole rigamarole. It’s more tedious than it needs to be. I don’t care for the icon driven platforms for this reason, it’s a mess. I spent a lot of time in settings trying to find where to reset things, and I did, but it would be helpful to not have these previously listened to check boxes blocking you from going back, just let us click a back arrow. Thank you

reviews.title: Taking more money
reviews.text: Loved the app until they just put even the daily meditation reading behind a pay wall. I’m sure more is to come. It’s just another money grab now

reviews.title: BIY/CIY are more difficult to scroll through episodes than any other app
reviews.text: I have been participating daily in BIY and CIY. I have been bookmarking episodes for the upcoming week or so for a while to minimize the amount of scrolling through episodes to find my place. When I scroll, seemingly no matter how careful I am, I either land on the previous screen and have to start over or inadvertently mark episodes as complete. Is there a setting that can make this workable? I’m on episode 145 on each and scrolling through to bookmark more episodes is becoming more and more unbearable.

reviews.title: No closed captioning
reviews.text: Need closed captioning for those who are hard of hearing for the videos. Also, Spanish needs to be added as well.

reviews.title: Difficulty
reviews.text: Great resources but, I have found it difficult to get around as well as the people that I have suggested follow the Lent  program that I’m on with Father Colombia Jordan.  Sometimes it’s hard to find him sometimes one has to wait for things to show up or other things get sent to you that you may not want like all this buying and selling of material and all these other prophetic voices that may indeed be wonderful, but I am interested in one person right now and not being flooded going through pages to find the correct site.  What I have recommended it to my friends they give up, trying to find it and sent her around the one thing.  It’s too much of a great thing which makes it not very good to get around..

reviews.title: Awful App
reviews.text: This app is awful. The interface is not intuitive. There’s no good way to get to content you’re using. In the three weeks I’ve tried this app, the Home Screen layout has change a half dozen times. Moreover, the only reason I gave this app a try was to get access to the fourth season of the Catholic Classics podcast, which is free and used to be available on all podcast sites but now Ascension is foisting itself on us and presenting subpar content. The first three seasons of Catholic Classics featured writings by Doctors of the Church. Now we get Thomas à Kempis, who intentionally or not, inspired the Modern Devotion motion that paved the way for  the Protestant Reformation. Imitation of Christ isn’t a Catholic Classic; it’s a Protestant primer. This app and this season of Catholic Classics has been incredibly disappointing.
